DIALOG.TITLE: What
DIALOG.CONTACT_PLACEHOLDER: Search a contact by name, phone or email
DIALOG.LOCATION_PLACEHOLDER: Address, video call link or phone
DIALOG.NO_FREE_SLOTS: No free time that day for this type. Pick another day, or set the time by hand.
DIALOG.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google Calendar did not answer: its busy times were left out.

GOOGLE.TITLE: Google Calendar
GOOGLE.NOT_CONNECTED: Connect your Google Calendar: your appointments go there, and what is busy there shows here.
GOOGLE.CONNECTED: Connected as {email}. Your appointments go to its main calendar.
GOOGLE.RECONNECT: Google stopped accepting the connection with {email}. Connect again to keep syncing.
GOOGLE.ERROR: Could not start the Google connection.
GOOGLE.READ_ERROR: Could not read {count} Google Calendar(s) right now; their busy times are missing.

RESULT.missing_scope: Google did not grant access to the calendar. Connect again and allow every permission.
RESULT.failed: Could not connect Google Calendar. Try again.

SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: The kinds of appointment you book and when each person attends. Together they decide the free times offered.
SETTINGS.NO_TYPES: No appointment type yet. Create one to get free times suggested when booking.

TYPE.NAME: Name
TYPE.AI_BOOKABLE: The AI can book this type
TYPE.AI_BOOKABLE_HELP: In the chat, the AI asks which day and time suit the customer and offers free times of this type. Needs someone who attends by default, with working hours.
TYPE.REMIND_HELP: A WhatsApp message before the appointment. For now only on numbers connected by QR code.
TYPE.REMINDER_MESSAGE_HELP: Use {name}, {date}, {time}, {type} and {link} (the Google Meet link, or the place).
TYPE.REMINDER_DEFAULT: Hi {name}! A reminder of your {type} on {date} at {time}. If you cannot make it, just reply to this message.
TYPE.GOOGLE_MEET_HELP: The event on the attendee's Google Calendar gets a Meet room; {link} puts it in the customer's messages. Needs the attendee's Google Calendar connected.
TYPE.BOOKED_STAGE: When booked, move the deal to
TYPE.NO_SHOW_MESSAGE: Message when the customer does not show up
TYPE.NO_SHOW_MESSAGE_HELP: Sent on WhatsApp (QR code) when the appointment is marked "Did not show up". When the customer replies, the AI offers new times. Use {name}, {date}, {time}, {type} and {link}. Empty: nothing is sent.
TYPE.NO_SHOW_DEFAULT: Hi {name}, we missed you at your {type} today. Would you like to book another time?

HOURS.TITLE: Working hours
HOURS.DESCRIPTION: The days and times each person attends. Without working hours, nobody is offered free times for that person.
